items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Art Hodes and Maxine Sullivan... we stopped on the way and made an album which is recently out called, 'We Just Couldn't Say Goodbye', and that of course was with Art Ho[de] and a group of musicians from down that way.

ctx.x: up here in Southern Pines for Joe Robertson, a double feature, Art Hodes and Maxine Sullivan. And while I was down there I got stranded because it snowed in New York and I couldn't get home. George Buck came up to Southern Pines and he agreed to make a recording so we stopped on the way and made an album which is recently out called, "We Just Couldn't Say Goodbye", and that of course was with Art Ho[de] and a group of musicians from down that way. And . . .
And there are two more in the works?
